name: @missura/example-compat
//dependencies: The official vendor SDKs are how half B generates the calls an SDK consumer would actually make; `graphql` parses the documents this suite sends so the read-only assertion is a parse, not a regex.
//devDependencies: The proxy is booted IN-PROCESS (`createServers`) so the suite depends on neither the vault nor the CLI, and missions are minted straight from `@missura/core`. The three connectors are imported for their NARROW only — a `ConnectionConfig` without one is not spellable, deliberately. These are the only @missura/* imports and they exist to boot the proxy; nothing here asserts through missura code.
